text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you thanking me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Because it was fun. So, thank you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I was always relying on 
Groove-san, wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Being able to run in the same race like 
this, and getting to see a side of you I 
don't usually see, Groove-san... It made 
me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I have no intention of saying 'Same 
here.' If you were satisfied with just 
this, it would be quite a letdown."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're someone driven by deeper desire, 
aren't you, Fine? There's still time— Wish 
to meet on the turf once more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you desire me with such desperate 
longing, I'll show you a run that 
surpasses even today's.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah, I'll think about it!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness! You have a call from your 
elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ! By elder sister, you mean—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Fine Motion's sister, she's a 
legendary Umamusume active on the world 
stage. I've only heard rumors about her, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
They mentioned that they would like to 
speak with Lady Air Groove, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really are Onee-sama's favorite, 
aren't you? Groove-san—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, don't patch them through! Tell them 
I've already gone home!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Captain, I'm sorry, but could 
you please tell Groove that I can't speak 
with her?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, in that case, they said 'hand 
over your Trainer'..."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"—Hiiie, are you the Trainer of my 
beauteous princess?"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘Frightened? What a shame, I prefer those 
with a stronger spirit. If you're frail, 
I'd have to hold back, wouldn't I?’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's older sister, whom I had 
never spoken to before... had quite a 
unique personality.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘A bit anticlimactic, but fine. I can 
still fulfill my objective. Now, let's get 
down to business.’"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
“――Thank you. I just really wanted to tell 
you that.”

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"You see, she had always been fulfilling 
my duties in my stead. As you can see, I 
was selfish and set my sights on racing 
early on."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"'She denies it and says it was her own 
choice, but... I've felt guilty in my 
heart all this time. That I was the one 
who locked that innocent child away in the 
castle.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"So seeing that child running freely in 
Japan... made me feel relieved."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for letting her speak her true 
feelings, and for letting her run freely 
through the wide world."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"'From here on out as well,' please take 
care of her."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"What are you talking about? Can I listen 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, is that a sweet little bird 
chirping? Put Fine Motion on the line, 
please."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hello, dear sister? Thank you so much for 
the passionate love letter the other day. 
I was truly moved by it.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"It was hard putting my love for you into 
words... I finally finished writing this 
after running halfway around the globe."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of you, Onee-sama! Then, 
were those spots spilled here and there 
sweat? And here I thought it was black 
tea?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
"‘They are tears of deep yearning, of 
course. Though a bit of Assam tea might 
have gotten mixed in.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sisters' conversation continued after 
that at their own peculiar pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And before heading back from Hokkaido to 
summer camp... an unexpected incident 
occurred."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Fine-san! Is it true that you're quitting 
racing!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Captain?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...I have confirmed it. It appears that 
word of our meeting following our return 
to the country has leaked out from 
somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
... Regardless, it is not something that 
can be concealed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once this year is over... I will 
return to Ireland and fulfill my mission.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! We won't be able to see Fine 
run anymore!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so very much for all your 
support up until now."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And lastly... I have a favor to ask of 
everyone."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I really want you to see my final race. I 
promise to keep your eyes—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...No. I absolutely want to carve my mark.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So, make sure you watch me. Will you... 
keep your eyes on me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We will hold a press conference at a later 
date with more details. Now then... if you 
will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps Fine Motion's sincere feelings got 
through to them, because the fans quietly 
saw her off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And once we returned to the camp lodge... 
there was something I needed to tell her. 
It was about our next target race."
choice_data_list: This might be our last race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list:
I've narrowed the candidate races down to 
four.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Considering the timing, the prestige of 
the race, and above all, rivals that would 
allow her to genuinely enjoy racing, the 
choice was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup, Mile Championship, and Arima 
Kinen—these four races.
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear your opinion.
I'd like to hear your opinion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Just asking, but I could run in all of 
them, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's just... you want to decide which race 
you want to be your final one, in peak 
condition... right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Could you let me think about it for a 
bit?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please, give me one day. I need to... make 
up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will she end up making that decision all 
on her own again?
choice_data_list: (No, I'm sure it won't come to that)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing that, I decided to leave it in 
her hands this once.
